verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so tracking-pixel blocking and mail-data transparency are fair questions for it, but the pack has no first-party evidence that it blocks read pixels or senders' tracking, by default or otherwise. The only related item is a second-hand community note that Missive's help docs say mail is fetched through Missive's servers over TLS. That glancing disclosure does not show the product's own tracking protection.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
